description: Profile a raw 0x EVM wallet address on Base Mainnet (8453) for OFAC sanctions exposure, on-chain counterparty wash-trade concentration, ETH/USDC balances, transaction count, and ERC-8004 ownership (10 free trials/day, then $0.005 USDC). Returns riskScore (0-100), riskLevel, and ERC-8004 registration status. Do NOT pass a numeric ERC-8004 agent ID here — use nullclear_check_reputation for numeric agentId trust audits.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (default 8453 for Base Mainnet)

walletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed 42-char EVM wallet address on Base Mainnet to screen
